note: GitHub Actions runner usage per repository, stacked by type: self-hosted, standard (GitHub-hosted), or indeterminate (could not be classified).
methodology: Read every GitHub Actions workflow file in each repository.
Classify each job's `runs-on` label as self-hosted, standard (a GitHub-hosted image), or indeterminate when the label cannot be resolved (e.g. a variable or a custom group name).
Count jobs, not repositories, and stack them per repository — so a repository with many jobs contributes proportionally more.
population: Workflow job runner declarations, grouped by repository. Indeterminate declarations cannot be classified.
